ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 4 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — Mahatma Gandhi — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.originalText: Refeeding day 4 review of electrolytes, weight, and blood pressure

text.paragraph: Mr. Gandhi returns on the fourth day of refeeding. He has followed the dietitian's plan and today will eat about 20 kcal/kg, with goat's milk, curd, rice gruel, fruit, and dal in small meals. He takes thiamine, the multivitamin, potassium, phosphate, and magnesium as prescribed. The home blood draws planned for days 2 and 3 did not take place: the outside laboratory had no home-visit slot, and the gap was not escalated. The daily calls found no swelling, breathlessness, palpitations, or confusion. His strength is returning, he walked 1 km this morning, and his home sitting systolic pressure has risen to 130 to 138. [S]
